summary: routes approve/unapprove, shares revoke, policy add-entry/restore block --yes over MCP (mcp:write-flags=yes), so as MCP tools they only plan and carry an accurate read-only hint.
reason: These commands write only with --yes; without it they print a plan from live reads. Blocking --yes on the MCP surface keeps agent writes behind the CLI's --yes (or tailscale_execute with confirm=true) and lets live dogfood exercise the real plan path instead of a dry-run stub.
validated_outcome: TestNovelMutationsArePlanOnlyOverMCP asserts cobratree.DestinationFlagBlocked(cmd, "yes") for all five.
